digest.component_or_area: MCP on-box self-contained HTTP server exposure, auth, and autodeploy routing
propositions: An ADR must document the decision to expose a self-contained rebar MCP HTTP server via nginx /mcp/ TLS edge with static Bearer PAT authentication, loopback-bound with configured hosts/origins and auth_resource_server_url.

The autodeploy target for MCP must use blue-green immutable-release with atomic nginx upstream pointer swap and retire-when-idle logic, explicitly contrasting with review-bot stop-and-drain to avoid saturation gotchas.

MCP-minted op-certs for plan-review and completion-verifier must sign under the box's existing REBAR_OPCERT_ENV_ID and trusted environment without introducing a new environment or changing verify.require_environment single-value enforcement.

The ADR must cross-reference ADR 0049, ADR 0050, ADR 0079, and the local main-tracking updater precedent, and name all concrete config keys (transport, http_tls_at_edge, auth_resource_server_url, static verifier, trusted_environments.yaml, verify.require_environment).
ADR 0079 must carry an amendment section describing the mcp blue-green pointer-swap target with explicit contrast to review-bot drain pattern and bug-7b4a saturation rationale.
No runtime code or infrastructure changes; only documentation/ADR files are committed.
